cast.stranger: a man in a dark hooded jacket with the hood pulled far forward, the inside of the hood a void of solid black shadow where a face would be

shots.narration: Another twig snapped, this time closer.
shots.subject: the empty pine path
shots.scene: A flagstone trail runs down through tall pines toward a grey lake.
shots.action: nothing moves on the trail; a few needles drift down
shots.motion: a very slow push forward down the path

shots.narration: There, in the distance, was the outline of a human.

people.action: kneeling on the flagstones with his back to the camera
people.placement: large in the left foreground, seen from behind

people.action: walking up the trail toward the camera
people.placement: small and far down the path

shots.subject: the kneeling young man
shots.scene: Over the shoulder of a young man kneeling on a forest path, a distant hooded figure walks toward him.
shots.action: far down the trail the hooded figure keeps walking closer
shots.motion: a slow push in over his shoulder
